tasks.task: Recognize a crop disease from a photo of a leaf, in a field without internet
tasks.why: The answer is one of a known set of diseases, and the model has to run on a phone without a connection.

tasks.task: Read the number on a water meter from a photo taken by a meter reader
tasks.why: The answer has a fixed format, and a utility has thousands of meters to read every month. The model can run on the reader's phone.

tasks.task: Recognize the language of each message received by a hotline
tasks.why: The answer comes from a short list of languages, and every message needs it. The messages can stay on the hotline's own computer.

tasks.task: Write a personal reply to each complaint
tasks.why: The answer is new text that has to fit each complaint. A small model can do a narrower part of the work, such as choosing a standard reply for a person to adapt.

tasks.task: Draft the summary of a 150-page project document
tasks.why: The answer is new text, and the document is long and varied. A model trained on a wide range of text writes better summaries.

tasks.task: Answer any question a citizen asks about public services
tasks.why: The questions cannot be listed in advance. A small model can do a narrower part of the work, such as sending each question to the office that answers it.
